scope: The core Honmaru keep ensemble of Matsuyama Castle in Ehime as photographed in January 2009, including the three-story Main Keep, Small Keep, North and South Corner Turrets, Tammon connecting gallery and the Tenjin Turret as geographic context. Distant gate complexes and lower baileys are outside scope.

originalReview.notes: The main bailey panorama shows the layered keep and adjoining towers rising above the forecourt.
The close view shows the keep, connecting galleries and corner turrets above the massive stone retaining wall, with charcoal timber panels, white plaster and gray tile roofs.

quallaSearch.notes: Both exact published Qualla originals match the sole Commons uploads byte for byte. Urashimataro uploaded them as own work and applied PD-self. The distant 2025 street photo and the station image were not used.
